# Suede Audit

Suede Audit is a bounded public-site audit for same-origin link integrity, crawler access, entity schema, metadata, content structure, and answer-engine discovery signals.

## Primary URL

- Product: https://optimize.suedeai.ai/
- Source: https://github.com/JasonColapietro/suede-scan
- Implementation service: https://scan.suedeai.ai/
- Suede Labs AI: https://suedeai.ai/

## Method

The automated report fetches a submitted public page, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, and a capped set of query-free links on the same origin. It requires two dead responses before confirming a 404 or 410 destination and prepares a direct-link replacement only when every redirect hop is a same-origin 301 or 308.

Search-discovery checks use OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Googlebot. GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended are reported separately as non-scoring training or AI-use controls.

Each browser receives one free audit. The result is cached in that browser so its report route can reopen without another scan.

Unsigned shared snapshots are labeled unverified and cannot create a Prospect Lens handoff. A separate production-token-protected operator endpoint uses larger fixed crawl caps; it does not send email or write to a CRM.

The report does not run buyer prompts inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or another answer engine. A high readiness score does not guarantee citations, recommendations, or rankings.
